details.name: OverFootball
details.summary: Football in a stadium: control your players, pass and shoot.
details.author: overbait
details.description:
How to launch
1. Enable OverFootball in Garrison and press Play.
2. Open a custom lobby.
3. Map (Crafted): OverFootball map.
4. Tuning Pack: OverFootball tuning.
5. Keep the regular game mode; no extra Game Mode is needed.
Controls: select a footballer; R toggles ball follow, T cheers. The follow checkbox remains available. Q/W/E retain their previous actions.

Enabling the bundle does not select its map or tuning in the lobby.
details.changelog:
0.8.2 / 2026-09-29
Fixed malformed line endings in the tuning localization table, which prevented its names and tooltips from loading. Gameplay, camera behavior, art and audio are unchanged. Select OverFootball map together with OverFootball tuning; Ram Napkin Race tuning is not compatible with the football map.

details.name: Ram Napkin Race
details.summary: Drive colourful rams across a rolling road-carpet arena.
details.author: overbait
details.description:
How to launch
1. Enable Ram Napkin Race in Garrison and press Play.
2. Open a custom lobby.
3. Map (Crafted): Ram Napkin Race map.
4. Tuning Pack: Ram Napkin Race tuning.
5. Keep the regular game mode; no extra Game Mode is needed.
Controls: right click to drive; S to brake; Q to strike. Select your ram and press W to follow your ram or E to follow the active ram. Press the same key again for free camera.

Enabling the bundle does not select its map or tuning in the lobby.
details.changelog:
0.9.2 / 2026-09-28
Accepted release: synchronized input and lighting, native W/E camera follow, direct Q requests, uphill traction and reduced initiator impact slowdown. Active-holder outline uses ordinary borders to avoid the rc.2 Ready crash.
